description: Identify internal and external interfaces, API boundaries, and integration points

actions.description: Detect interfaces exposed to external systems
actions.llm_guidance:
Look for:
- REST/HTTP endpoints
- CLI argument parsing
- File format readers/writers
- Network socket operations
- Database connections
- Message queue consumers/producers

actions.description: Detect module/class boundaries within the codebase
actions.llm_guidance:
Look for:
- Public class methods
- Exported module functions
- Abstract base classes / interfaces
- Protocol definitions
- Callback patterns

Look for:
- C FFI bindings (ctypes, cffi)
- Fortran iso_c_binding
- JNI/JNA interfaces
- WASM exports
- Python C extensions

actions.description: For each interface, document the expected behavior
actions.llm_guidance:
For each interface, document:
- Input types and constraints
- Output types and guarantees
- Error conditions
- Thread safety requirements
- Performance characteristics

actions.description: Compile interface information into structured format
actions.llm_guidance:
Create specs/reverse/detected_interfaces.json with:
- external_interfaces array
- internal_interfaces array
- interop_interfaces array
- Each interface should have: name, type, methods/operations, consumers, providers

criteria: All entry points have interface documentation
Cross-module dependencies are mapped to interfaces
